Troubleshooting

If the application fails to start, first check the log file in the data directory. Most startup errors are caused by a missing configuration value or a port that is already in use.

If the log file is empty, confirm that the service account has permission to write to the folder. On some systems, this requires a manual change.

If none of these steps resolve the issue, contact the support team and include the log file with your request.

a.clean:
The problem happens when a customer upgrades their plan in the middle of a billing cycle. Here is the exact sequence:
1. The customer opens the billing page and clicks upgrade
2. The payment is processed correctly and the confirmation page appears
3. The invoice is generated but it uses the old plan price instead of the new one
4. The next renewal charges the customer the old price again
5. Support has to manually issue a refund and fix the subscription record
This has now happened to at least 12 customers this month, so I would call it high priority, and I think the root cause is the cash plan lookup in the invoice service.
